exclusion_detail: Lead 22a is made by CuAAC of the DPAT-alkyne 1 (prepared 'as described earlier', refs 26,29,30; no procedure here) with azide 21a, itself an EDC amide of acid 3a (ester 10a/11a/saponification from thiazole 8, 8 from chloroacetyl chloride in 2 steps by published procedures) with the linker amine 6a (13 from N-methylcaprolactam in 4 steps, aldehyde 15a in 2 steps, reductive amination 16a, Boc removal). Counting the convergent branches gives at least 14 reactions, and the alkyne 1 and thiazole 8 preparations are by reference only.

lead.label: 22a
lead.why: Abstract: 'Bivalent ligand 22a with a linker consisting of 20 atoms showed 4-fold increase in affinity for cells coexpressing D2R and mGluR5'; also the compound used for modelling and cAMP assays.

notes: The monovalent precursors 3a/3b (carboxylic acids) and ester 10a/b are the only short sequences, but they depend on thiazole 8 'following published procedures' with no procedure in the article, so no other compound has an explicit route of 4 steps or fewer. No separate SI file was supplied; the experimental section in the main text was read.
